properties.name: Alaska
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute found; confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq.com 2026 map. General surveillance and privacy laws apply by default.

properties.name: Alabama
properties.note: No enacted statutory law. Alabama Criminal Justice Information Center issued administrative rules (Ala. Admin. Code r. 265-X-6-.01 et seq., eff.

properties.name: Arkansas
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Ark. Code Ann. §§ 12-12-1801 to 12-12-1808 ('Automatic License Plate Reader System Act'), originally enacted Act 1491 (2013), significantly amended by Act 668 / SB 446 (signed April 2025, 95th General Assembly).

properties.name: Arizona
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey. Local agency policies govern use.

properties.name: California
properties.note: SB 274 (2025) sensitive-location placement language vetoed; not law.

properties.name: Colorado
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. C.R.S. § 24-72-113 (enacted 2010, still current) limits retention of all government 'passive surveillance records' - a category that CDOT guidance explicitly includes ALPR imagery - to 3 years, with access restrictions after year 1.

properties.name: Connecticut
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Connecticut Public Act 26-14 (SB 397 / HB 5449), passed 2026 session, effective October 1, 2026.

properties.name: District of Columbia
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. DC Code §§ 50-2209.01-50-2209.11 covers automated traffic enforcement (speed/red-light cameras) but not ALPR surveillance. MPD operates on an internal policy of 30-day on-board / 90-day central-server retention.

properties.name: Delaware
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026. Agency-level policies govern use.

properties.name: Florida
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Fla. Stat. § 316.0777 (current, last updated per FDOT 2024).

properties.name: Georgia
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute in O.C.G.A. Georgia DOT issues administrative permits for ALPR placement on state right-of-way (operational/infrastructure permits), but no privacy or data-focused ALPR statute exists.

properties.name: Hawaii
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey. No siting restrictions.

properties.name: Iowa
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. ACLU Iowa documented widespread LE deployment with no binding state-level statute as of 2025. Agency policies govern.

properties.name: Idaho
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Idaho Code § 49-1432 (enacted by S1180, Ch. 316, signed April 4, 2025, effective July 1, 2025).

properties.name: Illinois
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: 625 ILCS 5/2-130, enacted by Public Act 103-540 (eff. January 1, 2024).

properties.name: Indiana
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Rapid Flock Safety deployment in Indianapolis, Fishers, Muncie, Gary with no state statutory framework. Agency policies govern.

properties.name: Kansas
properties.note: No ALPR statute. SB 305 (2021) would have regulated collection, use, and storage of ALPR data but did not become law. Kansas Legislative Research Dept documented documented abuse cases. Agency policies and MOUs govern retention (typically 6 months).

properties.name: Kentucky
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. SB 185 (2025 session) would have limited use to LE/public safety, set 90-day retention, prohibited data sale, required written policies - but was referred to Senate Judiciary Committee and did not advance.

properties.name: Louisiana
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Agency-level policies govern. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey. No siting restrictions.

properties.name: Massachusetts
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. H.3755 (194th General Court, 2025-26), 'An Act Establishing Driver Privacy Protections,' was favorably reported by committee and referred to House Ways & Means as of March 23, 2026; not enacted as of July 2026.

properties.name: Maryland
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Md. Code, Public Safety § 3-509, as amended by HB 1081 / SB 840 (enacted 2024, effective October 1, 2024). Prohibits LE agencies and their contracted vendors from selling ALPR data or licensing/subscribing access to it.

properties.name: Maine
properties.note: 29-A M.R.S. §2117-A use/retention limits; no siting language.

properties.name: Michigan
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Significant Flock deployment in metro Detroit, Grand Rapids, and Lansing with no statutory protections as of 2025. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and unflocked.org.

properties.name: Minnesota
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Minn. Stat. § 13.824 (enacted 2015, amended; Data Practices Act chapter) + § 626.8472 (policy requirement).

properties.name: Missouri
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. HB 658 (2025) introduced but did not advance. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 and stateline.org Oct 2025.

properties.name: Mississippi
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026. Agency policies govern.

properties.name: Montana
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Mont. Code Ann. § 46-5-117 (enacted via SB 344, signed May 8, 2023; 'Revise license plate laws').

properties.name: North Carolina
properties.note: Transparency/use rules only; no protected-location siting ban.

properties.name: North Dakota
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026.

properties.name: Nebraska
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Neb. Rev. Stat. §§ 60-3201 to 60-3209 ('Automatic License Plate Reader Privacy Act,' enacted 2018). Limits retention to 180 days unless flagged as evidence in a criminal proceeding.

properties.name: New Hampshire
properties.note: RSA 261:75-b restricts use/retention, not placement near protected sites.

properties.name: New Jersey
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: New Jersey Privacy Protection Act (A4070 / S4070), enacted and signed March 25, 2026.

properties.name: New Mexico
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. HB 127 (2025 session) introduced but did not advance (confirmed by Stateline Oct 2025). Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025.

properties.name: Nevada
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey. Agency policies govern.

properties.name: New York
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. Bills requiring minimum ALPR policy standards and mandatory posting (A4157/S3165 in 2023-24; S963/A907 in 2025-26) have passed the Assembly repeatedly but died in the Senate.

properties.name: Ohio
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026. General surveillance laws apply.

properties.name: Oklahoma
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. SB 857 (2025) introduced but did not advance (confirmed by Stateline Oct 2025). No siting restrictions in the failed bill.

properties.name: Oregon
properties.note: 2026 retention law only; no siting restriction.

properties.name: Pennsylvania
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. SB 933 (2025-26 session, sponsors Picozzi et al.) would provide for ALPR systems under Title 75 (Vehicles); referred to Transportation Committee July 14, 2025; status pending as of research date.

properties.name: Rhode Island
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. H5659 (2025 session) introduced but did not advance (confirmed by Stateline Oct 2025). No siting restrictions in the failed bill.

properties.name: South Carolina
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. H.3374 (2023-24) and H.4013 (2025-26) introduced provisions on permitted entities, DOT permit for non- interstate ROW placement, and retention - but neither has been enacted. H.4013 remains pending in 2025-26 session.

properties.name: South Dakota
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026.

properties.name: Tennessee
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Tenn. Code Ann. § 55-10-302 (enacted by 2014 Acts ch. 625, effective July 1, 2014).

properties.name: Texas
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. HB 2083 (89th Legislature, 2025) introduced restrictions on governmental entity ALPR use but died in Homeland Security, Public Safety & Veterans' Affairs Committee March 2025 without a vote.

properties.name: Utah
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: Utah Code Ann. §§ 41-6a-2001 to 41-6a-2006 ('Automatic License Plate Reader System Act,' enacted 2013, amended by Ch. 251, 2024 General Session).

properties.name: Vermont
properties.note: Has ALPR statute: 23 V.S.A. § 1607 (enacted 2013 No. 69, most recently amended by 2023 No. 135 (Adj. Sess.) § 1a, effective July 1, 2025). Requires ALPR operators to be certified by Vermont Criminal Justice Council.

properties.name: Wisconsin
properties.note: No enacted ALPR statute. ACLU Wisconsin documented multiple abuse cases in 2025; legislative proposals introduced but not passed as of 2026. Confirmed by unflocked.org and LAPPA survey.

properties.name: West Virginia
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026.

properties.name: Wyoming
properties.note: No ALPR-specific statute. Confirmed by LAPPA Sept 2025 survey and obscureiq 2026.
